ccswitch-native-bridge.description: Allow the 514cc loopback control-center page to call the explicit desktop bridge commands.

pet-window.description: 514 pet overlay window: drag handle and click-through toggle only. The pet page never calls native bridge commands.

window-chrome.description: Console-form wave 7: the frameless main window lets the loopback control-center page drive window controls (minimize/toggle-maximize/close) and manual drag regions. Kept separate from ccswitch-native so the native bridge capability stays exactly in sync with the invoke handler.
